description: Return live aggregate statistics for the Proximens GEO Engine knowledge base. INPUT: none. RETURNS: JSON with total_categories and the last-distillation timestamp; Pro/Enterprise tiers additionally get total_principles (high-confidence count), the full corpus size, a confidence_distribution and the last-validated timestamp. USE WHEN you need to gauge the size and quality of the corpus before relying on it.
name: proximens_geo_get_stats
title: Get GEO Engine statistics
